\begin{chapstatus}{The thread of this chapter}
A game is finished when someone else can run it: a portable cartridge, honest metadata, a bundle tested on another computer and a token kept secret. Next: machines faster than one core.
\par\medskip\textbf{Exit ticket} (two to four minutes, alone, on paper):
\begin{enumerate}[nosep,leftmargin=2em]
\item cartridge summary prints import\_model: abi-table. What does this say about the cartridge, and why does the Store accept only such cartridges?
\item You published version 1.0.0 and found a bug. What do you publish now? Where must the Store token never appear?
\end{enumerate}
\end{chapstatus}
